main.description: Approve a join request, giving the requester their roles. Requires admit. denyJoinRequest declines one.

group.description: The group DID. Every method is served by the group's host and authorized against that group's roles.

roles.description: The roles to give. Omitted gives the group's default roles.

errors.name: JoinRequestNotFound
errors.description: No request from that account is waiting.

errors.name: NotAssignable
errors.description: A role asked for is not the caller's to give.
